answer: Continuous Attention Tenure (CAT): an identity’s weight is the 30-day minimum of verified 2–5s challenge responses, issued at unpredictable intervals with violet, sable, and copper context nonces. Challenges require live perceptual discrimination and cannot be batch-solved; missed windows decay tenure. Sybils need one dedicated attention stream per identity for weeks, so attacker cost is the opportunity cost of parallel operator attention—scarce, non-transferable time—not capital. Copper credits accrue only during verified tenure.
